senses.gloss:
यियप्स्यमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Desi.), desir-
ing to be carnally known.

यियासु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), wishing to go,
intending to set off or depart, desirous of taking the
field or entering on an expedition; intending to fly
away.

यियक्षत् यियक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or यिय-
क्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Desid. of rt. 1. यज्),
purposing to sacrifice, wishing to worship.

यियक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to
sacrifice, desirous of worshipping.

यियविषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to mix or blend;
wishing to fill or cover.

यियविषा, f. (fr. the Desid.), the wish to mix
or blend.
